reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Failure to survive decedent by one hundred twenty hours
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule deeming a person who fails to survive decedent by 120 hours to have predeceased for homestead, exempt property, and intestate succession.

headings.title: Exception preventing state escheat of intestate estate
headings.reviewNote: Covers nonapplication of 120-hour survival rule where application would cause intestate estate to escheat to the state.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the 120-hour survival rule for homestead, exempt property, and intestate succession, and the exception preventing state escheat under section 474.010 (Effective 6-10-81).

headings.title: Parent and child relationship for adopted persons
headings.reviewNote: Covers parent-child relationship of adopted person as child of adopting parent and exception for stepparent adoptions.

headings.title: Parent and child relationship for persons born out of wedlock
headings.reviewNote: Covers parent-child relationship for persons born out of wedlock via marriage ceremony or paternity adjudication/proof (with father inheritance condition); notes 1985 Social Security annotation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on intestate parent-child relationships for adopted persons and persons born out of wedlock; notes 1985 8th Circuit annotation applying section to Social Security survivor benefits.

headings.title: Gifts in fraud of marital rights treated as testamentary dispositions
headings.reviewNote: Covers surviving spouse election to treat gifts in fraud of marital rights as testamentary dispositions recoverable from donees.

headings.title: Presumption of fraud on real estate conveyance without spousal assent
headings.reviewNote: Covers presumption that real estate conveyance by married person without written spousal assent is in fraud of marital rights.

headings.title: Court-authorized conveyances by or for disabled spouse
headings.reviewNote: Covers court-authorized conservator assent or conveyance deemed not in fraud of marital rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on gifts in fraud of marital rights, rebuttable presumption on unjoined real estate conveyances, and court-authorized conservator conveyances; notes cross-reference to section 442.035.

headings.title: Surviving spouse elective share against will and descent effect
headings.reviewNote: Covers elective share of one-half or one-third, taking by descent with nothing under will, and predeceased effect for death-accruing benefits; notes 1984 case annotation on abatement.

headings.title: Offset of homestead allowance against elective share
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that elective share is not in lieu of homestead allowance but homestead allowance is offset against the elective share.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on surviving spouse elective share (one-half or one-third), descent/predeceased effect, and homestead allowance offset; notes 1984 case annotation on abatement statute inapplicability.

headings.title: Estate valuation and offset of property derived from decedent
headings.reviewNote: Covers calculation of estate value for elective share purposes and offset of nonprobate property derived by surviving spouse.

headings.title: Categories of property derived from decedent
headings.reviewNote: Covers enumerated categories of derived property including lifetime trusts, power of appointment, life insurance, annuities, pensions, and community property.

headings.title: Survivorship in cotenancies and accounts derived from decedent
headings.reviewNote: Covers attributing sole ownership or life interest from survivorship cotenancies/accounts except proportions contributed by spouse or blood relatives; notes 1986 annotation defining "contribution".

headings.title: Valuation timing of owned and transferred property
headings.reviewNote: Covers valuation of spouse property as of death or irrevocable transfer and exclusion of pre-death income.

headings.title: Presumption of derivation and burden of proof on surviving spouse
headings.reviewNote: Covers presumption that property owned or transferred by surviving spouse was derived from decedent unless proven otherwise.

headings.title: Rescission of election when less advantageous than will
headings.reviewNote: Covers surviving spouse permission to rescind election to take against the will if computed elective share is less advantageous than will provisions.

headings.title: No refund required for property derived from decedent
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that nothing in this section requires the surviving spouse to refund to the estate money or property derived from the decedent or its value.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all seven subsections on elective-share estate valuation, derived property categories, cotenancies, valuation timing, presumption, rescission, and no-refund rule; replaced completely mismatched draft headings/notes on subsections 6 and 7 and noted 1986 case annotation.

headings.title: Intestate share entitlement of omitted surviving spouse and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Covers intestate share for spouse married after will execution unless omission was intentional or outside transfer was intended in lieu; notes 1984 case annotation.

headings.title: Abatement of devises to satisfy omitted spouse share
headings.reviewNote: Covers abatement of testamentary devises under section 473.620 to satisfy omitted spouse's share.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on omitted surviving spouse intestate share with exceptions and devise abatement under section 473.620; notes 1984 case annotation on class gift to in-laws.

headings.title: Intestate share of children born or adopted after will execution
headings.reviewNote: Covers intestate share for children born or adopted after will execution subject to three statutory exceptions; notes 1989 case annotation.

headings.title: Share of living child omitted under mistaken belief of death
headings.reviewNote: Covers intestate share entitlement for living child omitted from will solely due to testator's mistaken belief child was dead.

headings.title: Recognition requirement for illegitimate child of male testator
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that male testator recognized illegitimate child during lifetime or in will to qualify under omitted child provisions.

headings.title: Abatement of devises to satisfy omitted child share
headings.reviewNote: Covers abatement of devises under section 473.620 to satisfy omitted child's share.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on omitted after-born/adopted children, living child believed dead, male testator recognition of illegitimate child, and abatement under section 473.620; notes 1989 case annotation.

headings.title: One-year family support allowance and distribution
headings.reviewNote: Covers reasonable money allowance for surviving spouse and dependent minor children for maintenance during administration up to one year.

headings.title: Property selection in lieu of money and exemption from claims
headings.reviewNote: Covers selection of estate property in lieu of money support allowance and exemption from all claims.

headings.title: Real estate selection procedure under homestead rules
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of section 474.290 partition and conveyance procedures when real estate is selected for support allowance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on one-year family support allowance, property selection in lieu of money with claim exemption, and real estate selection under section 474.290 (Effective 5-23-96).

headings.title: Homestead allowance amount, beneficiaries, and selection
headings.reviewNote: Covers homestead allowance amount, priority for surviving spouse or unmarried minor children, and selection of real or personal property.

headings.title: Conveyance of selected real estate by personal representative
headings.reviewNote: Covers duty of personal representative to convey selected real estate by deed to person entitled.

headings.title: Excess value options for cash payment or undivided interest
headings.reviewNote: Covers surviving spouse options when selected property exceeds allowance value (cash payment of difference or undivided interest); notes 1960 case annotations on conveyance and partition.

headings.title: Set off of selected tract by partition
headings.reviewNote: Covers court authority to set off selected real estate from larger tract by partition without prejudice to owners.

headings.title: Appraisals and judicial determination of property value
headings.reviewNote: Covers court orders for property appraisal and determination of value after notice and hearing.

headings.title: Exceptions to valuation, public sale, and credit against purchase price
headings.reviewNote: Covers written exceptions to valuation, public sale in lieu of conveyance, and credit of homestead allowance toward surviving spouse bid.

headings.title: Waiver of homestead allowance upon late application
headings.reviewNote: Covers waiver of homestead allowance if application is not filed within ten days after expiration of claim filing period.

headings.title: In lieu of dower and homestead; vested rights preserved
headings.reviewNote: Covers allowance in lieu of dower and homestead, bar on post-January 1, 1956 homestead vesting under sections 513.495 and 513.500 (repealed L. 1957 p. 292 § 1 per source note), and preservation of previously vested rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all eight subsections on homestead allowance cap, real estate conveyance, excess-value options, partition set-off, appraisal/hearing, valuation exceptions/public sale, waiver, and dower/homestead bar; refined subsection 8 title and noted repealed-sections footnote (513.495/513.500) and two 1960 annotations.

headings.title: Competency of general witnesses to attest will
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that any person competent to be a witness generally may act as an attesting witness to a will.

headings.title: Validity of will and forfeiture of excess devise by interested witness
headings.reviewNote: Covers validity of will attested by interested witness and forfeiture of devise exceeding intestate share absent two disinterested witnesses.

headings.title: Status of creditors and named executors as disinterested witnesses
headings.reviewNote: Covers qualification of creditors and named executors as non-interested attesting witnesses absent personal beneficial interest.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on attesting witness competency, interested-witness excess devise forfeiture absent two disinterested witnesses, and creditor/executor status; notes two 1954 case annotations.

headings.title: Procedure and form for making written will self-proved
headings.reviewNote: Covers procedure, acknowledgment before authorized officer, and statutory certificate form for self-proved written wills.

headings.title: Officers lacking official seal and recitation of authority
headings.reviewNote: Covers officers lacking official seal, including commissioners of deeds and military officers, reciting facts of authority in lieu of seal.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections including the embedded statutory self-proving certificate form table in subsection 1 and no-seal officer authority recitations in subsection 2 (Effective 6-12-91).

headings.title: Requirements and validity of nuncupative wills
headings.reviewNote: Covers conditions for oral wills in imminent peril of death, requirement of two witnesses, writing within thirty days, and probate within six months.

headings.title: Limitation to personal property not exceeding five hundred dollars
headings.reviewNote: Covers limitation of nuncupative wills to personal property not exceeding aggregate value of five hundred dollars.

headings.title: Written wills unaffected by nuncupative will
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that a nuncupative will neither revokes nor alters an existing written will.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on nuncupative will imminent-peril requirements, $500 personal-property limit, and non-revocation of existing written wills (L. 1955 p. 385 § 263).

headings.title: Petition for determination regarding no-contest clause enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Covers petition by interested person for court determination whether proposed motion or claim triggers a will no-contest clause.

headings.title: No-contest clause defined
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory definition of no-contest or in terrorem clause and non-adjudication of enforceability in particular facts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on declaratory petition for will no-contest clause application under section 456.4-420 and statutory definition of no-contest / in terrorem clause (L. 2014).

headings.title: Revocation of first will upon physical revocation of second will
headings.reviewNote: Covers revocation of first will upon physical destruction of second revoking will unless circumstances or declarations show contrary intent.

headings.title: Revocation of first will upon third revoking will
headings.reviewNote: Covers revocation of first will when second will is revoked by third will except to extent third will expresses revival intent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on effect of revoking a second will by physical act or third will on the first will; notes 1961 and 1964 case annotations.

headings.title: Charge or encumbrance not deemed revocation of will
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that charge or encumbrance on property to secure debt does not revoke previous devise of same property.

headings.title: Exoneration rules for pre-execution versus post-execution encumbrances
headings.reviewNote: Covers devisee taking subject to pre-execution liens but taking exonerated from post-execution liens absent contrary intent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on property encumbrances not revoking prior wills and exoneration rules for pre-execution vs. post-execution liens; notes cross-references to sections 473.287 and 473.387.

headings.title: Failed non-residuary devise becoming part of residue
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that failed non-residuary devises become part of the residuary estate subject to anti-lapse provisions.

headings.title: Failed share passing to remaining residuary devisees
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that failed share of one residuary devisee passes proportionally to other residuary devisees subject to anti-lapse provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on failed non-residuary devises passing to residue and failed residuary shares passing proportionally to remaining residuary devisees, subject to section 474.460 (Effective 1-01-81).

headings.title: Deposit of will with probate division and certificate of deposit
headings.reviewNote: Covers deposit of lifetime will with probate division and clerk issuance of certificate of deposit.

headings.title: Sealing, endorsement, and confidential retention of deposited will
headings.reviewNote: Covers court-approved sealing, endorsements on wrapper, and prohibition on opening until delivered or disposed of.

headings.title: Lifetime delivery restrictions and post-death notification
headings.reviewNote: Covers lifetime delivery restricted to testator or authorized agent and post-death notice to endorsed recipient.

headings.title: Public opening, executor notice, and venue transfer
headings.reviewNote: Covers public opening within thirty days after notice of death if undelivered, notice to executor, and retention of true copy upon venue transfer; source cross-references section 488.1010.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on lifetime will deposit, sealing/confidentiality, delivery restrictions, and public opening within 30 days after death notice; corrected subsection 4 title ("within" vs. "after" 30 days) and noted cross-reference to section 488.1010.

headings.title: Formal requirements for valid electronic wills
headings.reviewNote: Covers electronic will requirements including readable text record, signing by testator or at direction, and two attesting witnesses.

headings.title: Extrinsic evidence of testator intent
headings.reviewNote: Covers admissibility of extrinsic evidence to establish testator's intent that the electronic record constitute the will.

headings.title: Witness state residency and location absent self-proving affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement under sections 474.337 or 474.550 that a witness be a state resident physically located in a state at signing if no contemporaneous self-proving affidavit is signed.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on electronic will execution requirements, extrinsic evidence of intent, and witness state residency/location absent a contemporaneous self-proving affidavit (L. 2025 H.B. 754).

headings.title: Revocation of previous wills by electronic will
headings.reviewNote: Covers authority to revoke all or part of a previous will by means of an electronic will.

headings.title: Methods for revoking electronic will
headings.reviewNote: Covers revocation of electronic will by subsequent will, written instrument, or physical act proven by preponderance of evidence.

headings.title: Presumption of revocation upon unlocated electronic will
headings.reviewNote: Covers presumption of revocation when signed electronic will and certified paper copy cannot be located following death.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on electronic wills revoking prior wills, methods of revoking an electronic will, and presumption of revocation when unlocated after death (L. 2025 H.B. 754).

headings.title: Creation and affidavit requirements for certified paper copy
headings.reviewNote: Covers affirmation under penalty of perjury creating certified paper copy of electronic will and inclusion of self-proving affidavit.

headings.title: Certified paper copy satisfying legal original requirements
headings.reviewNote: Covers satisfaction of statutory or procedural original-form presentation requirements by certified paper copy of electronic will.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on creating a certified paper copy of an electronic will under penalty of perjury and satisfying original-form requirements (L. 2025 H.B. 754).

headings.title: Electronic execution of written estate planning documents
headings.reviewNote: Covers validity of electronic execution for written estate planning documents including trusts, powers of attorney, and deeds.

headings.title: Attribution of electronic document or signature to person
headings.reviewNote: Covers standards and proof for attributing electronic estate planning document or signature to a person.

headings.title: Counterpart execution and certified paper copy
headings.reviewNote: Covers counterpart execution in electronic or paper form and creation of certified paper copies under penalty of perjury.

headings.title: Witnessing in electronic presence for non-will documents
headings.reviewNote: Covers electronic presence witnessing of non-will written estate planning documents requiring witness signatures.

headings.title: Immunity and assumed validity for persons acting in reliance
headings.reviewNote: Covers nonliability and right to assume valid execution for persons acting in reliance on electronically executed estate planning documents.

headings.title: Electronic signing not required for written documents
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that electronic signing of written estate planning documents is permissive and not required.

headings.title: Application of general state law and equity
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of general Missouri law and equitable principles to electronic estate planning documents except as modified.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all seven subsections on electronic execution of written estate planning documents, attribution, counterparts and certified paper copies, electronic witnessing of non-wills, reliance immunity, permissive scope, and general law/equity (L. 2025 H.B. 754).

headings.title: Emergency remote execution definitions
headings.reviewNote: Covers definitions of "applicable state of emergency" (April 6, 2020 to December 31, 2021, citing executive orders 20-08 through 21-09), "estate planning document", "necessary person", and "physical presence requirement".

headings.title: Requirements satisfying physical presence during state of emergency
headings.reviewNote: Covers criteria for satisfying physical presence via video conference, Missouri location, notary journal, and remote interaction.

headings.title: Attorney affidavit of remote execution and statutory form
headings.reviewNote: Covers satisfaction of remote execution requirements through certified written affidavit and form executed by licensed Missouri attorney.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on COVID-19 state-of-emergency remote execution definitions (April 6, 2020 to December 31, 2021), remote physical-presence criteria, and embedded statutory attorney affidavit form table (L. 2025 H.B. 754).
